claim: EKS Hybrid Nodes networking is flexible to your preferred method of connecting your on-premises networks to a VPC in AWS; documented options include AWS Site-to-Site VPN, AWS Direct Connect, or your own VPN solution.

evidence.quote: This is flexible to your preferred method of connecting your on-premises networks to a VPC in AWS. There are several [documented options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-vpc-connectivity-options/network-to-amazon-vpc-connectivity-options.html) available including AWS Site-to-Site VPN, AWS Direct Connect, or your own VPN solution, and you can choose the method that best fits your use case.
